swift.reference: Independent affine position/normal, diffuse, fog and world-plane equations; no production CPU/shader helper

metal.reference: Independent affine position/normal, diffuse, fog and world-plane equations; no production CPU/shader helper

scope: Tween POSITION1/NORMAL1 independently interpolate before world and inverse-transpose normal transforms. Seventeen declaration formats, primary-normal omission, full factor range, lighting/fog, world planes, multiple/constant streams match independent analytic/preprocessed geometry pixels. Factor is uniform-only and reuses shader/pipeline. Missing both secondary channels refuses the draw. D3D9 factory/device advertise TWEENING after CPU and real GPU validation; D3D8 remains unadvertised pending declaration CPU input. No native Microsoft D3D8/9, full Wine or game/FPS claim.
